DharmaNexus text-reuse computations show extensive Pali-internal formulaic reuse, most prominently with the subsequent rule on traveling by boat with a nun (Pācittiya 28, sharing §0.1–2.12) as well as the parallel rules against traveling by arrangement with women (Pācittiya 67) and thieves (Pācittiya 66) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns the rule with Tibetan versions of the *Vinayavibhaṅga*, the *Vinayasūtra*, and the *Vinaya-uttaragrantha* [DharmaNexus]. An English translation has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
